usageNotes: Call this before creating a VM or container to obtain a free VMID that Proxmox will not assign to another resource. When called without a vmid, it returns the next available ID cluster-wide; when called with a specific vmid, it asserts that ID is currently unallocated (returning the same ID on success, or an error if already in use). Note that the returned ID is not reserved — a concurrent creation race is possible on busy clusters, so use it promptly.

examples.summary: Get the next free VMID (no preference)

tips: Pass a specific vmid (e.g. 200) to validate your desired ID is free before a planned deployment — useful in scripted provisioning workflows.
The returned VMID is not locked; on clusters with high VM creation frequency, call this immediately before the create request to minimize collision risk.
VMIDs below 100 are reserved by Proxmox; the minimum valid value is 100.
